source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle for each unit with this ability, when this unit is picked to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may use this ability: its ranged attacks get +1 to [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) for the rest of the phase.

Mark the unused ability with Ammo Runt tokens beside the unit (as many as you like), and remove them on use.
